correctness.rationale: The specified local model is the completion of the standard graded three-dimensional section ring R_d=⊕_{m≥0} H0(P1,Sym^m(O(1)⊕O(d))). For each m, Sym decomposes as ⊕_{b=0}^m O(m+b(d-1)); h0(O(q))=q+1 for q≥0. Thus h_R(m)=(d+1)m²/2+(d+3)m/2+1 exactly; its leading coefficient equals e(R)/2!, hence e=d+1. Completion preserves Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity. The independent symbolic combinatorial calculation for d=1,2,5,11 and m=0,1,2,5,12 matched the polynomial. Application to a single fixed threefold and increasing d_i explicitly depends on the Li–Li formal-neighborhood and unbounded-degree existence assertions as cited, not separately reproved from its inaccessible full text.
